notes.content: [h2]Changes[/h2][list][*][p]The Abandoned One’s chain now rattles as he moves, giving players an audio cue of his presence[/p][/*][*][p]Nightmare mode will no longer roll the Spores modifier until after 2 cycles have been completed, allowing time to prepare and purchase gas masks[/p][/*][*][p]The negative modifier bonus multiplier is now concealed in Nightmare mode, since showing it defeated the purpose of the modifier being a mystery (players could correlate the bonus value to the modifier itself)[/p][/*][*][p]High score tracking added to Snake[/p][/*][/list][h2]Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed the pickaxe not saving on the train correctly, which would result in errors when reloading the save file[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where Nightmare mode could roll with no modifier - it now always applies a random negative one[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a null reference error related to items that could occur for clients when late joining[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where client equipment would remain visible when deployed and holstered quickly due to latency[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: v1800
notes.content: [h1]The Mineshaft[/h1][h2]Searchlight, Nevada[/h2][h3]July 4, 1992[/h3][p][i]"The orange clouds found us three hundred feet underground. Seeping through rock, drifting down ventilation shafts we thought were sealed. Command said it was just "atmospheric disturbance" from California. [b]We all knew they were lying.[/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]Couple weeks into stripping this mining depot. Yesterday the first cloud rolled through storage. The workforce without masks started dissolving from the inside - coughing up pieces of themselves before dropping. One of the engineers got a single breath before his mask sealed. Now he sits in the corner, swelling, groaning as his body expands. Growing into something else. We locked him in storage but we can still hear him changing.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]A recon team checked the lower tunnels this morning. Found their clothes. No bodies. Just the absence of people who used to exist.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]The surface must be completely orange by now. These spores drift east from California, finding every crack down to us. Command's been static for three days. The train was supposed to come yesterday. [b]They're not coming.[/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]Three hundred feet underground with two weeks of supplies and no way out. The lift's dead. Even if we could climb, there's only orange death above.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]If you find this, stay away. The spores are still here. [b]We're still here.[/b] Don't come looking."[/i][/p][p][b][i]- Overseer Silas[/i][/b][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]LOCATION BRIEFING[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]MANDATORY RESPIRATORY PROTECTION:[/b] Gas mask required for all personnel - site contaminated with California-origin spore particles[/p][/*][*][p][b]RESOURCE EXTRACTION AUTHORIZED:[/b] Mining equipment available for ore recovery operations along tunnel perimeters[/p][/*][*][p][b]NO AMBIENT LIGHTING:[/b] Facility lacks illumination infrastructure - portable light sources mandatory for safe navigation[/p][/*][*][p][b]OPERATIONAL HAZARDS:[/b] Atmospheric exposure without proper filtration results in immediate personnel loss. Multiple structural breaches and excavation pits present - exercise extreme caution during movement protocols[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h1]The Casino[/h1][h3]Chicago, Illinois[/h3][p][/p][h2]Slot Machines[/h2][p][i]The workforce haunts these rows like it's the only church left standing. Each soul sinking into private communion with their chosen machine. Pull the lever. Watch the reels blur. Let everything else fade to static. The symbols that spin past feel dredged from collective memory - patterns everyone knows but no one can place, [b]like warnings written in a dead language.[/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]The machines hum their electric lullabies, patient as priests. They know when to grant small mercies - three matching symbols here, a handful of credits there. Just enough light to keep the moths circling. Outside waits the endless cold, the spores, the things that hunt. Inside, there's only the next pull, the next spin, the next chance.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]The regulars have worn grooves in their spots, each one tethered to their particular altar. They don't speak, don't look away, don't stop. In this fluorescent sanctuary, the only salvation is the jackpot that never comes. The only horror is when your credits run dry and reality creeps back in.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]Wheel of Doom[/h2][p][i]The wheel waits in permanent stillness until you arrive. Then it seems to exhale, ready. One spin daily - a ritual carved so deep into routine that your hands know the motion even if your mind has forgotten why. They find the worn spots where countless fingers have gripped before. [b]All of them yours.[/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]Credits or corruption - mere decorations for the others. But between the wedges, in the spaces where the wheel blurs, you see them: the verdant gardens, sun that burns away the cold, fragments of a purpose you once carried like gospel. You've been here before. [b]Many times.[/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]The wheel remembers that December day you first touched it. It remembers the plan you believed would save everyone. Patient as winter, [b]it waits for you to remember too.[/b][/i][/p][hr][/hr][p][i]"Christmas in the casino. The ECD herded us here for 'morale' - as if slot machines could make us forget California's complete destruction. Ten days since we lost the California workforce for good. The workforce pretends to celebrate while the [b]ECD pretends we're not next.[/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]I found something at the wheel today. Or [b]it found me.[/b] It showed me fields beyond this winter - green stretching endlessly under warm sunlight. Not memories. Something else. [b]A promise of what waits beyond.[/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p][b][i]It wants me to return.[/i][/b][i] Daily. Like a ritual. Said I'd forget all of this if I miss even one day. Forget there's anything beyond the cold worth finding.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]California proved we can't hold against what's coming. But maybe we don't have to. Maybe there's another way through. A way to poison it from the inside.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]The others drink their rationed beer and waste credits on slot machines. [b]They don't know what I saw.[/b] They wouldn't believe it anyway. Growth where there should be only death. A weakness in what took California.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]Tomorrow I'll spin again."[/i][/p][p][b][i]- V, December 25th, 1991[/i][/b][/p][hr][/hr][h1]New Modifier: SPORES[/h1][p]Thick clouds of toxic spores now drift through the environment, their orange-tinted masses creating a suffocating atmosphere that proves lethal to anyone without proper protection.[/p][p]Within these poisoned zones, The Carrier emerges - a corrupted being that explodes into deadly clouds of contamination.[/p][list][*][p]Requires a gas mask to survive - without one, suffocation occurs[/p][/*][*][p]Reduces AI vision distance by 33%[/p][/*][*][p]Carriers appear in high numbers within the spore-contaminated area[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h1]Gas Mask Authorization[/h1][p][i]Emergency respiratory protection equipment has been cleared for immediate distribution to personnel operating in contaminated zones:[/i][/p][list][*][p]Gas Mask units available for requisition from Supply Officers[/p][/*][*][p]Provides full protection against airborne spore contamination and atmospheric toxins[/p][/*][*][p]Military-grade filtration system rated for Category-3 biological hazards[/p][/*][*][p]Reinforced seal design maintains integrity during extended exposure to hostile environments[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][i]"More equipment notices for a workforce that barely exists. The ECD still pretends they're managing hundreds when we're down to a handful of people.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]Orange death crawls eastward from California's grave. [b]We're all that's left of humanity[/b] - the Chicago workforce, the last ones still breathing.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]The Pentagon mission happens soon. 'Humanity's Last Hope,' they call it. [b]I know what waits there. They don't. Ten months of visions have shown me how this ends.[/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]When the spores reach Chicago, this mask will let me walk the contaminated tunnels one last time. The fluorescent stars will guide me to where I need to be. They think this is about surviving the mission. [b]They don't know I'm not planning to come back.[/b]"[/i][/p][p][b][i]- V, September 27th, 1992[/i][/b][/p][hr][/hr][h1]NEW ENTITY ALERT[/h1][h2]Designation: "THE CARRIER"[/h2][h2]Classification: NIGHTMARE[/h2][h2]Threat Vector: Explosive Contamination/Biological Warfare[/h2][p][/p][h3][b]CHARACTERISTICS[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Severely bloated humanoid form with visible internal distension[/p][/*][*][p]Advanced stage spore infestation throughout body cavity[/p][/*][*][p]Unstable biological structure - prone to catastrophic detonation[/p][/*][*][p][b]SPORE-ORIGIN CONTAMINATION:[/b] Entity manifestation linked to California incident[/p][/*][*][p][b]SUICIDE BOMBER BEHAVIOR:[/b] Approaches targets with intent to detonate at close proximity[/p][/*][*][p]Emergence patterns correlate directly with spore concentration levels[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]ENCOUNTER PROTOCOL[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Upon visual contact:[/b] [b]IMMEDIATE RETREAT[/b] - do not approach under any circumstances[/p][/*][*][p][b]Engagement authorization:[/b] Close quarters combat [b]TRIGGERS INSTANT DETONATION[/b] - [b]RANGED ELIMINATION ONLY[/b] - entity detonates upon projectile impact[/p][/*][*][p][b]Proximity breach:[/b] [b]EMERGENCY EVACUATION[/b] - explosive radius exceeds safe engagement distance[/p][/*][*][p][b]No containment protocols available[/b] - entity termination through controlled detonation only[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]DETONATION EFFECTS[/b][/h3][p][b]Carrier elimination results in:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Immediate explosive blast[/b] - lethal within 6-meter radius[/p][/*][*][p][b]Secondary spore dispersal[/b] - contamination cloud expands post-detonation[/p][/*][*][p][b]INFECTION PROTOCOL:[/b] Direct exposure to blast materials results in progressive biological breakdown[/p][/*][*][p][b]Conversion timeline:[/b] Approximately 3.2 minutes from exposure to complete ████████[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]CONTAMINATION ZONES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Multiple Carriers manifest in spore-affected territories[/p][/*][*][p]Expect escalating Carrier manifestations in high-contamination areas - [b]entity density is rising with prolonged atmospheric degradation[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Entity density correlates to proximity of ████████ ██████ ██████[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]CRITICAL ADVISORY[/b] The Carrier represents [b]WEAPONIZED BIOLOGICAL CONTAMINATION[/b] in entity form. Standard engagement protocols [b]COMPLETELY INEFFECTIVE[/b] due to explosive nature. [b]MAINTAIN MAXIMUM DISTANCE[/b] - entity serves as both weapon and plague vector. Personnel exhibiting post-exposure symptoms must [b]REPORT TO ECD TRAUMA RESPONSE IMMEDIATELY[/b] for mandatory evaluation. Treatment protocols will be determined based on contamination progression and subject viability assessments. [b]COMPLIANCE WITH TRAUMA RESPONSE DIRECTIVES IS NON-NEGOTIABLE.[/b][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]ENTITY EVOLUTION REPORT[/b][/h2][h2]Designation: "HOLLOW SPIDER"[/h2][h2]Classification: NIGHTMARE[/h2][h2]Threat Vector: Multi-Sensory Predation/Advanced Tracking[/h2][p][/p][h3][b]CHARACTERISTICS[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]OPTICAL DETECTION CAPABILITY[/b] - entity demonstrates functional vision[/p][/*][*][p][b]ACUTE AUDITORY SENSITIVITY[/b] - dramatically improved sound detection range[/p][/*][*][p][b]INCREASED LOCOMOTION SPEED[/b] - enhanced pursuit velocity beyond baseline measurements[/p][/*][*][p][b]ADAPTIVE HUNTING PROTOCOLS[/b] - combines visual and auditory target acquisition[/p][/*][*][p][b]ACCELERATED COCOONING PROCESS[/b] - target immobilization occurs significantly faster than baseline measurements[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]ENCOUNTER PROTOCOL[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Upon detection[/b] - Break visual contact and remain motionless until departure confirmed[/p][/*][*][p][b]Audio discipline[/b] - [b]MAINTAIN ABSOLUTE SILENCE[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Positioning protocols[/b] - Avoid exposure in open corridors[/p][/*][*][p][b]Evasion protocols[/b] - [b]DO NOT ATTEMPT TO OUTRUN[/b] - enhanced speed eliminates flight as viable option[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stunlight deployment[/b] - [b]RECOMMENDED EQUIPMENT[/b] - optical disruption temporarily blinds entity due to newly developed vision capabilities, creating escape opportunities[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]CRITICAL ADVISORY[/b] The Hollow Spider represents [b]UNPRECEDENTED SENSORY EVOLUTION[/b] within this entity classification. Standard concealment protocols [b]NO LONGER PROVIDE ADEQUATE PROTECTION[/b]. Combined optical and auditory detection capabilities render previous evasion strategies [b]CRITICALLY COMPROMISED[/b]. [b]Increased pursuit speed negates traditional escape methods[/b]. All personnel must [b]ASSUME IMMEDIATE DETECTION[/b] in any environment where both visual contact and sound emission occur simultaneously.[/p][hr][/hr][h1]Player[/h1][h2]Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Retextures and improvements for clothes and backpack[/p][/*][*][p]Hoodie and backpack now match the player’s flavor color[/p][/*][*][p]You can now "give up" while being carried by the Butcher[/p][/*][*][p]Breathing adjustments to blend ratios, exponent values, and volume scaling[/p][/*][*][p]Overhauled equipment movement sounds[/p][p]the old sounds had sharp metallic tings that felt distracting, so they’ve been reworked to sound more natural and less intrusive[/p][/*][/list][p]V (Male) - Suffocation Vocals by @AnThranOfficial[/p][p][i]"i broke enough things in this game, now i'll help build it!"[/i][/p][h2]Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed equipment not visually holstering for other players when picked up until equipped[/p][/*][*][p]Player outline now resets during respawn to prevent cases where it could remain stuck on[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where healing while infected or paranoid did not properly clear the wounded effects[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where explosions would sometimes fail to kill players[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where colliders on collected equipment items weren’t disabled, which could block interactions with other objects[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a mistake where the male player’s minimum paranoia sound cooldown was 8 seconds instead of 15 seconds, matching the female player’s cooldown[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved a bug causing equipment foley sounds to pan incorrectly when the player leans[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h1]Data Deck[/h1][h2][b]Snake Mini-Game[/b][/h2][h3]Play the classic Snake game directly on your Data Deck during downtime or while spectating.[/h3][p][/p][h3][b]How It Works[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Access via "snake" button next to inventory[/p][/*][*][p]Earn credits based on your score performance[/p][/*][*][p]Perfect distraction while waiting on your fellow workforce[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Credit Rewards[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Score converts to credits automatically upon game over[/p][/*][*][p]Provides alternative income source[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2][b]Data Deck Skin System[/b][/h2][h3]Discover abandoned data decks throughout the world. Each one unlocks a unique skin for your device.[/h3][p][/p][h3][b]How It Works[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Find themed data decks hidden in various locations[/p][/*][*][p]Pickup to permanently unlock the skin[/p][/*][*][p]Apply skins via [b]Options > Gameplay > Deck Skin[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Some skins unlock through Transcendence milestones[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Launch Skins[/b][/h3][p]Nine skins available to discover:[/p][list][*][p][b]RetroDeck[/b] - 80s off-white plastic with bright accents [b](Transcendence 1)[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]LostDeck[/b] - \[REDACTED] - [b][i]"The truth waits where time stands still"[/i][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]ECD[/b] - Standard-issue for ECD personnel - [b][i]"Where the last orders were given"[/i][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]BlingDeck[/b] - Gold-plated luxury edition - [b][i]"Hidden in the nation's most secure vault"[/i][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]MedDeck[/b] - Emergency medical personnel issue - [b][i]"Where vaccines once brought hope"[/i][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]SporeDeck[/b] - Sprouting with corruption - [b][i]"Where the Nevada workforce became something else"[/i][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]FleshDeck[/b] - Organic nightmare - [b][i]"Where the workforce became inventory"[/i][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]CasinoDeck[/b] - The house always remembers - [b][i]"The wheel saves special prizes for old friends"[/i][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]FairyDeck[/b] - made in fairyland drip [b](Transcendence 10)[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i]"I keep finding their decks scattered through the metro, still latched to bodies in the corners where they died. Each one tells me who they were before all this. Each one belonged to someone who still believed the ECD's promise - that they'd see the sun again. [b]Their legacy lives on.[/b]"[/i][/p][p][b][i]- V, August 29th, 1992[/i][/b][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]General Data Deck Changes[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Overhauled Data Deck Model and Textures[/b][/p][p][i]Data Deck Model 7 - Refined geometry and textures keep the familiar design intact while revealing the intricate wear patterns of a device that's witnessed too much.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Finally removed the color preview when selecting a Data Deck flavor as it didn't serve any purpose[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h1]Train[/h1][h2]Modifiers[/h2][h3][b]Changes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Negative modifiers now provide increased loot value as compensation for added difficulty[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue with world modifiers - rolls that landed on blocked modifiers could result in none being applied. Rolls now re-roll until a valid modifier is chosen (some locations block specific modifiers, which caused the issue)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where flashlights could remain on when entering a location affected by EMP modifier[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Removed Modifiers[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Removed infestation modifier[/b] (was frequently skipped by players), additionally the double spawns from Nightmare Mode has also been removed[/p][/*][*][p][b]Removed fog modifier[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]The fog modifier was never very well received and honestly just didn’t look that great. With the addition of the spores modifier - which is more polished, better looking, and far more interesting to play around - the fog has been retired.[/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]General Train Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the location monitor did not refresh with updated information after leaving a location, causing it to display outdated values[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where debt would scale incorrectly after being paid off, causing unexpectedly high debt amounts in subsequent cycles. Debt progression now increases as intended, based only on the correct base value and not the previously paid-off debt[/p][/*][*][p]Adjustments to debt scaling[/p][/*][*][p]Added safeguards to debt calculation to prevent an edge case where a player’s debt could become stuck at 0[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed lamp on train not following train movement[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h1][b]Shop[/b][/h1][h2]Changes[/h2][list][*][p]The shop now closes when the train halts at a location - forcing players to prepare supplies in advance rather than stocking up mid-expedition[/p][/*][/list][h2]Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where sometimes newly purchased equipment could incorrectly sync as 0 durability instead of the starting max durability[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h1][b]The Plantation[/b][/h1][h2]Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Reworked exterior with improved detail and textures[/p][/*][*][p]Floor traps now have a 50% spawn chance, making navigation less predictable[/p][/*][*][p]Major optimization pass for improved performance[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h1]Loot Items[/h1][h2]Added[/h2][list][*][p]Carbide lamp[/p][/*][*][p]Drill bit[/p][/*][*][p]Stick of dynamite[/p][/*][*][p]Gunpowder tin[/p][/*][*][p]Oxygen candle[/p][/*][*][p]Coal ore[/p][/*][*][p]Gold ore[/p][/*][/list][h2]Sounds[/h2][list][*][p]Added unique pickup sound for gasmask[/p][/*][*][p]Added unique sounds for new mineshaft loot items[/p][/*][*][p]Changed plantation fancy plate pickup sound[/p][/*][*][p]The label maker now uses the tape roll pickup sounds, as the original sound files were lost to corruption and data loss in our cloud[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h1]Stunlight[/h1][h2]Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Added an overheated sound - provides feedback when it’s recharging and cannot be used[/p][/*][/list][h2]Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Improved obstruction detection - stuns should now feel more reliable[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the blast sound was cut off when the device broke (ran out of charges)[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h1]Sledgehammer[/h1][h2]Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed sledgehammering doors - now only the sledgehammer hit sound plays, removing the door kick sound that previously overlapped[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed sledgehammer hit sound desync for clients - the impact sound now correctly plays in sync across all players[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h1]Landmines[/h1][h2]Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Landmine spawn distance from doors reduced from 6 to 5 meters[/p][/*][/list][h2]Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where clients could not properly disarm landmines[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed landmine spawning algorithm to prevent placing mines in bunker doorways[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h1]AI[/h1][h2][b]The Butcher[/b][/h2][h2]Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Butcher AI could break if his victim died while being carried[/p][/*][*][p]Players no longer freeze from frostbite while being carried by the Butcher in cold locations[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]The Abandoned One[/b][/h2][h2]Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Abandoned One could target another player while executing a victim, causing him to get stuck running in place on top of the downed player[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h1]Contest Winners[/h1][h3][b]Added Community-Designed Cells[/b][/h3][p]Two new cells created from community blueprints submitted during our August cell design contest:[/p][list][*][p][b]Uncle Larry's Basement Cell[/b] (Plantation)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Griller's Inspection Hall Cell[/b] (Metro)[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Thanks to everyone who participated! It was really fun seeing all the creative designs. We might do another contest like this in the future.[/i][/p][hr][/hr][h1]General Changes[/h1][list][*][p]General performance optimizations applied across all locations[/p][/*][*][p]Added pickaxe equipment - randomly spawns in the mineshaft for ore mining[/p][/*][*][p]The Shepherd no longer spawns at the Tunnels[/p][/*][*][p]Removed unintended bleeding from water dispenser infection[/p][/*][*][p]Added rocky footstep sounds[/p][/*][*][p]Added new sounds for caged doors - includes open, close, and kick effects[/p][/*][*][p]Loot now spawns in the correct position inside the pentagon wooden desk[/p][/*][*][p]Flashlight and lantern now automatically turn off when leaving a location[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]This marks the end of major content development for Forsaken Frontiers as we transition to our next project. We set out to create something atmospheric and unsettling, and we're satisfied with where we've landed. Minor patches may still happen occasionally, but our creative energy is moving elsewhere. Thanks for playing and surviving the endless winter with us.[/p][p][/p][p]Special thanks to those who trusted my creative direction throughout development. Paths can’t be memorized, only carefully navigated.[/p][hr][/hr][p][i]"The ECD says they placed these mines under direct government orders in those final twenty-four hours before the collapse. 'Following the last official directive we received,' they claim.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]But that raises another question - where was the ECD before the collapse? I don't remember any 'Entity Containment Division' existing until after everything fell apart. [b]In twenty-four hours of complete chaos, when did anyone find time[/b] for this level of coordination with an organization that didn't seem to exist the week before?[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]The spacing is too deliberate. Like someone knew exactly where we'd need to walk.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b][i]Coordinators[/i] move through the minefield like they helped design it.[/b] But they're just promoted workforce members, right? Watch them navigate - no hesitation, no wrong steps. Like they've memorized something the rest of us aren't allowed to see. [b][i]Almost like there's more to that promotion than better rations and a new title.[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p][i]Hard to know what to believe anymore. It's been two weeks since Walker vanished. "Reassigned," they told me. But I know Thomas - he wouldn't just leave without a word.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]I'm keeping track now. The lies, the lost friends, the questions that never get answered. [b]One day, someone's going to answer for all of this.[/b]"[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i][b]- V February 28th, 1989[/b][/i][/p][hr][/hr][h2]The Pentagon[/h2][p][b]Pentagon Spawn Rebalancing[/b][/p][p]Entity spawns at the Pentagon have been adjusted. [h1]NEW ENTITY ALERT[/h1]
[h2]Designation:  "THE ABANDONED ONE"[/h2]
[h2]Classification: DEADLY[/h2]

"I've seen what grief does in this endless cold. It doesn't break you, breaking implies pieces that could be reassembled. "I still remember their faces pressed against the train windows as I stepped onto the Pentagon platform. Eyes widening in realization. Hands pounding glass. Mouths forming my name in silent screams as I forced the departure sequence. [b]The last of humanity pulled away into darkness. My final act of love before I transformed myself into weapon, into sacrifice.[/b]

The voice that guided me into hell spoke with my own mouth. [b]Every word carried the rhythm of my heartbeat, the cadence of my breath - but the intentions behind them were never mine.[/b] Safety was the sweetest lie I ever heard myself speak.

The ECD called these episodes "paranoia-induced hallucinations." [b]Clinical terminology for communion.[/b] They misdiagnosed my connection with The Entity as madness.

The voice still speaks to me even now; our war continues in dreams that bleed through reality's thin skin. [b]I walk endless corridors with faceless shadows. Each day the same stations, the same missions, the same motions - a grotesque puppet show where I perform for my captor, gathering trinkets for a master that feeds on my captivity while I secretly feed it poison.[/b]"[/i]


[h2]Pyrotechnic Distraction Unit Distribution[/h2]
Section Supervisors have approved the following equipment for immediate workforce deployment:
[list]
[*] Pyrotechnic Distraction Units (PDUs) now available through The Supply Officer
[*] Proven 72% effective at redirecting entity focus from personnel
[*] Short ignition delay allows for strategic deployment and withdrawal
[/list]
NOTICE: All workforce members are reminded that unnecessary noise attracts unwanted attention. PDUs are to be requisitioned only when authorized by Section Supervisors for Surface Operations.

[i]"I hold this string of small paper-wrapped tubes between frozen fingers, another 'gift' from our benevolent shepherds. [b]They've weaponized childhood memories now.[/b] Fourth of July celebrations corrupted into desperate distractions. How perfectly cruel that the holiday meant to celebrate our independence became the day we lost everything to the entities, and now its symbols serve only to mark time until our deaths.

Their sterile name 'Pyrotechnic Distraction Units' [b]priestly incantations masking ritual sacrifice.[/b] These aren't tools, they're admission tickets to our own funerals. [b]We're not distracting entities. We're just choosing where to die.[/b]

The Supply Officer's gloved hand brushed mine during the transaction. Was that hesitation I felt? His mask revealed nothing, but [b]I saw his fingers trembling, maybe we're not so different after all.[/b]

I pocket the firecracker, its weight insignificant yet somehow unbearable. Tomorrow I'll cast this tiny oblivion into the darkness and flee through corridors that only lead back to themselves. For a moment, the light of its detonation will tear reality open – a brief, violent illumination of our prison walls. A twisted fireworks show with no audience but the damned, no celebration but survival. The entities will converge on its echo, and in their ravenous pursuit I'll glimpse the terrible truth: [b]we're all just noise in the void, momentary disruptions in an endless silence[/b], running from one shadow into another.

Each explosion extinguishes something inside me. Another prayer abandoned, another hope surrendered to the cold. [b]These aren't rockets' red glare lighting the way to freedom – they're funeral pyres marking the graves of everything we once were.[/b]"[/i]

David Caldwell

In maintenance tunnels where frost wrote stories of abandonment across pipes and panels, I found its den. The space struck something deep inside me, a recognition that felt like swallowing shards of mirror - medical supplies arranged with the desperation I knew from our own shelters, canned food stacked in towers that reflected our own careful measurements of survival. Torn maintenance manual pages transformed into bandages, each fold a reflection of our own methodical fight against death. This wasn't a monster's lair. [b]This was tomorrow's reflection staring back at today.[/b]

The Packrat's scream carried [b]memories I'd tried to forget[/b] - that raw desperation from the evacuation, when summer died and mercy turned to ice. A sound that belonged to something that remembered warmth, that understood what it meant to lose it. Something that still [b]carried humanity's weight.[/b]

Pale light filtered through the tunnel's collapsed ceiling, turning stale air into cathedral breath. In that moment of almost-grace, the screaming stopped. The Packrat turned, and something shifted in its eyes - like watching ice crack to reveal the drowning beneath. Recognition. Memory. Trust. [b]It knew me.[/b]

The sledgehammer fell. One swing, and certainty shattered like glass. My light found something in the settling dust - an ID card worn smooth by time but [b]still carrying its burden of truth.[/b] Workforce ID 847. Thomas Walker. My friend. The one they'd marked as "processed" back when we still believed in tomorrow.

His scattered documents told a story written in unimaginable cruelty - transfer orders marked with Lab 7's cold signature, all bearing Walker's name like epitaphs. The word "processed" transformed in my hands, became something alive and terrible. The ECD hadn't detained him. Hadn't reassigned him. They'd taken my friend and remade him into this thing that died remembering me. All our desperate scavenging, all our faithful service, all our careful measures to keep humanity's flame alive - [b]we were never survivors to them. Just raw material waiting to be processed.[/b]

[b]Walker's blood marked my pilgrimage[/b] to The Director's office, each crimson drop striking concrete like truth finding earth. The sledgehammer weighed heavy in my hands, a pendulum of judgment still warm with revelation. Its surface caught the fluorescent light like morning sun on fresh snow, promises of retribution falling in steady drops that marked time's transformation from loyalty to understanding.

From maintenance tunnels into the ECD outpost's sterile halls, where clinical distance turned lives into paperwork. Thirty-seven swings. Between these pristine walls where bureaucratic procedure had masked methodical horror, where a signature could erase a person into oblivion, I rewrote their careful protocols in the only language they had left us. For a moment the outpost fell silent, I stood among shattered illusions of order, watching truth paint itself across floor and walls while the hammer dripped absolution.

Down the hall, boots thundered their own dark hymn. The sledgehammer loose in my grip now. Still warm with purpose, its message written in crimson clarity across pristine walls that had never known truth's texture. Let them come and process what they'd created.
 
The hammer's head rested against concrete, each red drop now marking time between [b]what I had been and what understanding had made me.[/b]"[/i]

notes.title: v1311
notes.content:
[b]New Features[/b]
- Added detection and handling for version mismatches.

[b]Changes[/b]
- Nightmare Mode now starts at the Hollowed difficulty level.
- Firebarrel collider fix.
- Removed the outdated onboarding sequence.
- Made additional adjustments to fog settings.
- Reduced the likelihood of the fog modifier.
- Fixed an issue causing excessive darkness in the train texture.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- The issues causing the "Black Screen of Death" and Spectators getting stuck should now be fixed.
- Fixed an issue causing an excessive number of doors to generate (bug introduced in v1310).

[i]We're aware of the performance issues some players are experiencing with v1310 and are working to resolve them as soon as possible. Thank you for your patience.[/i]

notes.title: v1310
notes.content:
[b]New Features:[/b]
- Players can now be burnt to death.

[b]Changes[/b]
- Entity vision is now halved in foggy conditions.
- Made slight adjustments to fog density and appearance.
- The starting cell now always generates a door.
- The initial door can no longer generate as locked.
- Adjusted door mechanics to require proper timing for enemy stuns, preventing spamming.
- Enemies are now stunned if struck by a door being knocked down.
- Knocking down doors is now seamless for client players, even at higher ping, when using the sledgehammer.
- Reintroduced vision fading, as it was not the cause of black screening issues.
- Removed cycle difficulty display from the Data Deck in Escape Mode.
- Fixed a desynced desk in the Tunnels Station.
- Lowered the volume of the electric shock sound effect.
- Improved audio clarity for elevator arrival sounds.
- Pentagon entity spawn times are now consistent across all difficulty levels.
- The unpaid travel fee per credit has been increased from $300 to $400.
- Slightly increased map generation speed.
- Increased map generation size.
- Reduced the time it takes to begin generating after pulling the train brake, and decreased the delay before the train departs after pulling the brake to leave.

[b]Nightmare Changes[/b]
- Nightmare Mode now begins at the withering difficulty level.
- In Nightmare Mode difficulty now increases with each cycle.
- Nightmare Mode debt starts at $100 credits now.
- Reduced Nightmare loot value multiplier from 2.5x to 1.55x.
- Nightmare Mode no longer doubles enemy spawns.
- Power now goes out at 8 PM in Nightmare Mode.

[b][i]With these changes, Nightmare Mode now offers a true challenge, aligning more closely with the difficulty the game was originally envisioned to have.[/i][/b]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Fixed a bug in Escape Mode where certain entities, such as the spider and ventress, were no longer spawning. (bug introduced in v1300)
- Fixed a bug that allowed equipment to be used while the Data Deck was open by swapping items between slots.
- Fixed an issue in the door code that prevented alarmed doors from showing a kicked motion when kicked, as well as other issues like the inability to lock the door or missing closing sounds.
- Fixed an issue where the stun animation for entities would occasionally fail to trigger.
- Made further adjustments to address and hopefully fix black screening issues on death.
- Fixed an issue where the Forsaken would not make any idle noises for client players.

notes.title: v1303
notes.content:
[b]Version: v1303
Date: November 8, 2024[/b]

[b]Changes[/b]
- Reduced starting debt to 50 credits.
- Buffed the stunlight by widening its cone from 45° to 55°.
- Fixed the stunlight’s positioning when holstered and equipped.
- Slightly decreased the scale of the pager and adjusted it's holster position.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Fixed bug where you couldn't use your data-deck while dead (introduced in v1300)
- Fixed a bug where the stunlight would continue to charge and fire if the player was downed while charging.
- Fixed a bug where medkits and adrenaline remained visible and usable after being consumed if the client player has very high ping.
- Fixed a bug where players would not perform the animation for checking their Data Deck when equipped with a sledgehammer.
- The bug where newly purchased items would sometimes have 0 durability for client players should now be fixed.

notes.title: v1302
notes.content:
[b]Version: v1302
Date: November 7, 2024[/b]

[b]Changes[/b]
- Toy car pickup isnt super loud anymore.
- Slightly adjusted cycle difficulty debt.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Fixed a bug that caused cycle difficulty to reset to "unbroken" after reaching the highest difficulty level.
- Fixed a bug that caused client players to become stuck after their boltcutters broke.
- Fixed timing desync issues for clients when using the boltcutters.
- Fixed a bug where broken equipment items would briefly remain visible to client players after breaking.

notes.title: v1301
notes.content:
[b]Version: v1301
Date: November 7, 2024[/b]

[b]Cycle Difficulty Changes[/b]
- Entity spawn times for each cycle difficulty have been increased and amount that can spawn decreased.

[i]This change aims to provide a more gradual progression, slowing the pace of the game's difficulty curve to give players more time to adapt and enjoy the early stages before the challenge ramps up.[/i]

[b]Changes[/b]
- Sledgehammer now consumes 20% stamina per use.
- Reduced the volume of the train derailment sounds, making it less jarring and more balanced with other in-game sounds.

[b]Sound Updates[/b]
Unique pickup sounds have been added for the following items:
- Perfume bottle
- Toy car
- Wirespool
Additional sounds have been added for:
- Picking up small metal scrap
- Picking up cardboard objects
 - General grab sounds

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Resolved an issue with the alarm door, ensuring it now correctly shuts off during all power outages, not just the Blackout modifier.

notes.title: v1300
notes.content:
[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Overhauled the game's progression system. Instead of a fixed linear difficulty, difficulty now dynamically scales over time. This affects debt accumulation rates, entity spawn times, and which entities appear in specific locations, providing a more adaptive and challenging experience as players advance.
[*] Added an option for "Host-Only Train Interactions" when creating a lobby, allowing only the host to operate the train to prevent griefing in public lobbies.
[*] Introduced a digital display on equipment, allowing players to easily view durability levels and other important information.
[*] Added Enemy Volume slider to the audio options.
[*] The Forsaken now have idle noises.
[*] Added a stunned animation for The Forsaken.
[*] Added unique pickup sounds for the lantern.
[*] Added pickup sounds for car battery.
[*] Added new easter egg.
[/list]
[b]New Equipment Added:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the Stun-Light, a powerful flashlight that can be charged to emit a blinding flash, temporarily disorienting and stunning enemies.
[*] Introduced the Sledgehammer, a new tool that allows players to quickly and loudly break down doors, providing a more aggressive entry option.
[/list]
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] The generator now properly shuts down at 5 PM, introducing an added layer of challenge to the Tunnels environment in Nightmare mode.
[*] Fixed an EXP imbalance in Nightmare mode, which was previously awarding excessively high experience, making it an unintended shortcut to reach Overseer status.
[*] Increased the rate at which the remaining loot value increases.
[*] Increased the player death fee from 30 credits to 50 credits.
[*] Adjusted travel fees to better balance the cost of traversing the world.
[*] Increased the mid-cycle scrap buying percentage from 70% to 75%
[*] Reduced the range at which the Spider can detect voice.
[*] Slightly nerfed the Spider's hunt parameters.
[*] Nerfed spider hearing from 2.55x to 2.3x
[*] Fixed how credits are displayed on the Debt Machine to handle larger values.
[*] Updated glowstick so its color is now set only once.
[*] Changed the pickup sound for cards and motherboard.
[*] New cell added to the Metro.
[*] Made adjustments to the train's lighting
[*] Adjusted Hotel Lighting.
[*] Adjusted Hospital Lighting.
[*] Fixed downed vending machine collider.
[*] Fixed Hospital Stuckspot
[*] Fixed a few hospital props clipping
[*] Fixed Hotel hallway clipping issue
[*] Added new loot spawn spot at hotel to close the gap between looting
[*] Fixed tunnels station spawning cells slightly off center
[*] Temporarily removed the fade system on death until the Black Screen of Death issue is resolved, which was causing the screen to become stuck instead of fading away.
[*] Increased game time a bit.
[*] Adjusted shop prices.
[*] Cutting locks with boltcutters now takes 2 seconds, instead of being instant.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where players could be attacked and killed by other enemies while already being attacked by the Ventress.
[*] Fixed a bug where players would appear to float when attacked by the Ventress.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game could end prematurely if the last remaining client player was downed with an adrenaline shot.
[*] Fixed an issue with the debt machine where pressing buttons while at a location could cause it to break until the clear button was pressed.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player's call-for-help voice wouldn’t follow their position, causing it to mistakenly sound as if coming from behind when crawling.
[*] Fixed a bug where players’ vision wouldn’t fade to darkness after the train crash.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed the remaining days counter to display -1 if a player disconnected on Debt Payment Day.
[*] Fixed a bug where the pager would remain active after a player was incapacitated.
[*] Fixed an issue where the glowstick was not saving correctly.
[/list]

notes.title: v1201
notes.content: - Fixed a critical bug affecting how gamemodes load from save files, ensuring correct gamemode settings are applied when resuming saved sessions.

notes.title: v1200
notes.content:
[b]Version: v1200[/b]
[b]Date: October 31, 2024[/b]

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Escape gamemode (work in progress): a high-stakes survival experience where players must join forces to break free from the ECD’s grasp. This mode highlights intense survival elements and the crucial role of teamwork to escape from captivity.
[/list]
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased item collider sizes to make loot easier to pick up.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved stability of procedural world generation to prevent instances of getting stuck.
[*] Fixed an issue where cells weren't always fully removed from memory after leaving a location, which could cause performance degradation over time.
[*] Made further adjustments to address the Black Screen of Death bug; this issue should now be resolved. (hopefully)
[*] Fixed an issue where elevators could become permanently stuck after being blocked by an enemy.
[*] Fixed the fall detection system to prevent players from intentionally getting stuck to trigger a free teleport back to the train.
[*] Fixed an issue where players would desync after being teleported, until they moved.
[*] Fixed Glowstick color for late joiners.
[*] Fixed a bug where Jack-o'-lanterns would turn off during train power outages.
[/list]

notes.title: v1110
notes.content:
[b]Version: v1110[/b]
[b]Date: October 29, 2024[/b]

[b]New Features:[/b]
- Implemented a temporary solution to address players falling out of the world, now automatically teleporting them back to the train to prevent progress loss.

[b]New Cosmetics:[/b]
- Jmdog pin added (code: jmdog).

[b]Changes:[/b]
- Fixed stuckspot at the train shop
- Hotel travel fee reduced from $200 to $150.
- Shamblers now spawn at 10 AM at the Hotel.
- Shamblers now spawn at 11 AM at the Metro.
- Slightly adjusted the minimum distance at which the Butcher room can generate.
- Removed a bar you could hit your head on at the metro pitfall.
- Added a zap sound effect when a player is electrocuted by jumping onto the train tracks.
- Reworked the holiday decoration system to eliminate reliance on the time server, ensuring a more stable and reliable experience for all players.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Resolved an issue where the speedrun timer would not reset after a run was reset.
- Fixed an issue where the EMP glitch effect would not trigger correctly.
- Enemies should no longer get stuck on each other.
- Fixed the Surplus modifier to behave as intended, no longer guaranteeing the spawn of every possible loot item.
- Fixed bug where you could revisit the Pentagon twice if you saved and reloaded after leaving the Pentagon.
- Fixed an issue where grabbing equipment at the same time as another player could cause item duplication.
- Made additional changes to address the Black Screen of Death.

notes.title: v1100
notes.content:
[b]Version: v1100
Date: October 27, 2024[/b]

[b]New Features:[/b]
- Introduced the Glowstick as a new equipment option, providing an affordable light source to illuminate surroundings.
- Added an option to enable a speedrun timer, allowing players to track their completion times and compete with others.

[b]New Cosmetics:[/b]
- Vorz pin added (code: vorz).
- Jahnkee pin added (code: jahnkee).
- Added additional pride flags.

[b]General Changes:[/b]
- Reduced the cost of shop items to make them more accessible to players.
- The train door battery now depletes slower and recharges faster.
- Enemy sensing adjustments have been made to ease overall difficulty.
- The Butcher room is now generated further into the level.
- The Ventress's patience has been shortened, allowing players to slip away from her grasp more easily.
- Reduced the frequency of Director speeches to minimize interruptions.
- Increased the number of hiding spots near train stations.
- Mouse sensitivity slider no longer allows for extremely high values.
- You can now self-revive as the last downed player regardless of whether it's a solo run.
- The Butcher can now hear you speak.

[b]Server Browser Changes[/b]
- The server browser should no longer be region locked
- Added the ability to scroll through the server browser.
- Lobbies containing friends should now always visible in the Friends Server list.
*friend lobbies now display if either:*
1.The host is on your friends list OR
2.Any friend is currently in the lobby

[b]Metro Changes[/b]
- Shamblers now spawn at 12 PM.
- The Ventress now spawns at 6 PM.
- The Spider no longer spawns here.
- Metro Pitfall now has an additional light to help players see
- The desk that cannot be hidden under is now more clearly distinguishable.

[b]Hotel Changes[/b]
- Shamblers now spawn at 11 AM.
- The Spider now spawns at 12 PM.
- The Ventress now spawns at 5 PM.
- Hotel Pitfall is now easier to navigate

[b]Hospital Changes[/b]
- Shamblers now spawn at 10 AM.
- The Spider now spawns at 12 PM.
- The Ventress now spawns at 2 PM.
- Amount of Shamblers changed from 3 to 2

[b]Tunnels Changes[/b]
- Shamblers now spawn at 8 AM.
- The Spider now spawns at 10 AM.
- The Ventress now spawns at 12 PM.

[i]These adjustments should make the experience more welcoming for new players and less punishing overall.[/i]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Fixed the Black Screen of Death.
- Resolved a bug where enemies were not properly responding to client voice.
- Fixed an issue where the workforce list would not display more than 6 players.
- Fixed Surplus modifier to no longer be affected by remaining loot value.
- Fixed an issue where The Ventress could become stuck standing in front of vents.
- Fixed a bug in solo mode where being downed with multiple adrenaline shots could incorrectly end the game, preventing self-revival.
- Fixed an issue where the candy bowl could be spammed.
- Fixed radio desync issues for players who joined a session late.
- Fixed desynced desks in the train station.
- Director volume settings now save correctly.
- Fixed train exterior lights being off during Halloween.
- Players should no longer be cocooned under desks or in narrow spaces.
- Getting rescued from cocoons should now be more stable, reducing the likelihood of clipping through the environment and falling.
- Fixed a bug where the held interaction prompt wouldn't clear when downed while using an object.
- Fixed a severe exploit where disconnecting from the game while at a location would store all scrap on hand and not progress the day, preventing players from abusing this to infinitely reset bad runs and farm money.

notes.title: v1094
notes.content:
[b]Version: v1094[/b]
[b]Date: October 23, 2024
[/b]
[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now eat from the candy bowl. (available exclusively during Halloween)
[/list]
[b]Changes:[/b]
